facts.fact: Paradigm Initiative's six-country study lists Resolution No. 52/2019 as the Strategic Plan for the Information Society (2019-2028) in its table of Mozambique's national digital strategies, led by MCTES, INCM and the Ministry of Communications and Digital Transformation.
facts.system: Plano Estratégico para a Sociedade de Informação 2019-2028

facts.fact: The study gives the Strategic Plan for the Information Society a 2019-2028 period and links the text of Resolution 52/2019 on a government site; as_of is the study's publication date.

facts.fact: The study says execution of the Strategic Plan for the Information Society is hampered by limited consolidated public reporting and heavy dependence on donor cycles, with World Bank projects financing broadband and governance work; as_of is the study's publication date.
